[SWS_CM_00081] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging to an event and eventReceptionDefaultValue is defined in case of Signal- Based IEEE1722 ACF network binding
⌈
If less data than expected shall be deserialized on the proxy side and the data to
be deserialized belongs to an Event and the eventReceptionDefaultValue is de-
fined, then the eventReceptionDefaultValue shall be used as a substitute for the
missing data.
⌋
